rows.scope: Complete mode: union of each requested word's chain in PHASES order, each phase once; one non-standard word kept as-is; custom or unknown word beside a standard word contributes nothing. Tokens abstract ASCII words; Register, "*" and empty lists outside domain. Native c2,c4,c6,c7,c8 and setup.

-only: one word runs only that phase (standard or declared custom, case-insensitive); two or more words become one comma-joined name that is neither standard nor custom and fails before any phase work. Runtime METHOD DOES NOT EXIST for the joined/unknown name is a native-qualified provider premise. Native c1,c3,c5,c9,c10,c11.

Per-step effects observed natively: START line per executed phase, "*" refresh silent, developer-mode Reload copies disk source, Compile compiles namespace source and runs After-Compile Invoke, Activate runs After-Activate Invoke and a nested complete Configure phase via %DispatchMethod, custom phase runs its Invoke, a non-dispatchable name prints START then fails and stops. Resource processors, source control hooks and lifecycle bodies other than these effects are not modelled.
